These pages read real data from public stores. They run on every
build of the site, but each remote read is guarded: if a store does
not answer the check made before the build, or this GDAL lacks what it
needs (Icechunk, for instance), the page says so in a callout instead
of failing. The [Stores](../stores.qmd) page lists every address with
its permanence and its last result.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from _common import *
used = [s for s in STORES.values() if any(u.startswith("gallery/") for u in s.get("used_in", []))]
ok = sum(live(s["key"]) for s in used)
print(f"At this build, {ok} of {len(used)} gallery stores were live.")
```
